notes: Makes the signed-out root route enter Auth0 Universal Login directly instead of adding a Kairo-owned credential step.
Moves Workspace creation to a dedicated authenticated /onboarding route and deterministically routes users with no Workspace there after callback.
Keeps passwords outside Kairo; Auth0 remains the credential boundary while Kairo retains Workspace and Brand authorization.
Uses the same standards-based Authorization Code + PKCE architecture that can be reused by future mobile clients with a platform-appropriate Auth0 application/callback.
Google remains enabled through Auth0 when configured; Apple is prepared as an Auth0 connection but is not claimed operational until Apple/Auth0 credentials are configured.
No release, deployment, Auth0 tenant mutation, Apple Developer configuration or production enablement is authorized by this slice.
